name: Machine chest fly
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Sit with your back on the pad and take a handle in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and bring the handles together in front of you.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.
cue: Hug the handles in, open slowly
mistakes: Letting the handles pull your arms too far back.
Pushing with bent arms, turning it into a press.
